experience.subject: A cinema frame that decorates around whatever video the user is already watching in another app (system player, PICO Video, browser): five ambient wall-treatment styles in real materials (Walnut Gallery, Béton, Linen Room, Smoked Oak, Bronze Line): low saturation, low brightness, no neon or glow, each with a soft light that fades during the show and an optional quiet ambience, with show lighting that follows the sound and a sleep timer. It does not play video, dim the room or control other apps.
experience.form: Shared Space only. A hollow 3D Volume (one of five ambient 3D wall-treatment styles) plus a small Planar controls window to its right. No Stage, because Stage forces Full Space, which hides other apps and stops their playback (verified on emulator, see feasibility.md).

surfaces.purpose: Main window. Transparent (no material background, base panel hidden), uniform resize only so the 16:9 opening keeps its shape. The user aligns it around the other app's player window by hand; Home Cinema cannot read other windows' poses. No recenter or bring-to-front promise.
Controls beside the frame (Placement.right of the Volume); never over the opening.

states.note: Shown automatically on first launch, then only from Align frame to player

actions.purpose: Loads the selected style's GLB (Walnut Gallery, Béton, Linen Room, Smoked Oak, Bronze Line) into the Volume with a 1.2 s cross-fade, switches its soft light (the one emit_* material: a baked wash or a hidden LED line) and ambience loop, updates the style line; remembered across launches.

Manual fallback. Start the show: Opening (the frame's soft light fades to 12 % over 4 s, ambience fades in) then Showing. End the show: Closing (soft light back to 100 % over 6 s, ambience fades out) then Lights up. Only our own frame lights change; the room is not dimmed.

When on (default), polls AudioManager.isMusicActive every 1 s: inactive to active starts the show; 8 s of continuous inactivity ends it. A manual press overrides auto until the next state change from sound.
Shows the alignment outline and the align panel; the system window handles of the Volume are highlighted; the soft light stays up so the opening is easy to see.
Hides the alignment aids. The Volume keeps the size and position the user set (the system restores it on next launch where supported).
Off / 60 / 90 / 120 min. On expiry runs End the show and stops ambience; it never pauses or closes the other app. A small remaining-time line appears under the status text while active.
Plays the selected style's looped ambience during Opening and Showing only; off by default.
Shows the Show or Settings page in the controls window.
Opens the language menu anchored to the language button.
Applies Follow system / Simplified Chinese / English to all strings immediately and persists it.
Finishes the activity and closes the frame Volume and the controls window.

designNotes.represents: The selected wall treatment as one 3D model (GLB, metres) filling the Volume around a 1.64 x 0.94 m hollow 16:9 opening; five ambient styles: Walnut Gallery, Béton, Linen Room, Smoked Oak, Bronze Line
designNotes.previewRepresentation: Transparent orthographic renders of the actual GLB (lights-up and showing variants), cross-faded by show state
appearance: Walnut Gallery: charcoal limewash wall panel, walnut shadow-box frame (4 members, grain along each), dark linen slip, 6 mm brass hairline, walnut ledge with a stoneware vase and art books (Tripo)
Béton: board-formed concrete panel with tie holes, 14 cm chamfered concrete reveal, concrete stub shelf with a travertine pebble sculpture (Tripo)
Linen Room: fabric-wrapped acoustic tiles in dark greige linen, walnut trim, a warm LED line under the top trim, walnut ledges with a linen-shade lamp and books (Tripo)
Smoked Oak: vertical smoked-oak slats on black felt, matte black steel sight frame, faint neutral bias light on the felt, small shelf with a stoneware vase (Tripo)
Bronze Line: black linen museum mat and a 3 cm darkened-bronze frame, nothing else
behaviors: Opening is hollow with no geometry and no collider, so rays reach the other app's window behind it

Each style has one material whose name starts with emit_ (a soft wash baked as an emissive map, or a hidden LED line): its emissive intensity follows the show state (Lights up 100 %, Showing 12 %, Opening 4 s / Closing 6 s ease)
No saturated colour and no bloom: frame mean chroma C* <= 8 and mean L* <= player L* - 15 in the Showing state (design-tools/ambient_check.py)
Switching style cross-fades over 1.2 s and switches the ambience loop; the choice is remembered
Uniform resize only; the model is scaled to the Volume (750 dp per model metre at the default size)
previewLimitations: Renders are lit by a neutral room environment and one key light; on device the passthrough room is not dimmed
Props are Tripo meshes decimated to 2.5k-3.5k triangles with 512 px textures, desaturated for the ambient look
